capture_consistency.scope: Container membership, image IDs and start times checked at both ends; API/settings observations are timestamped within this interval.

capture_mode: Read-only Docker metadata and direct source-file hashes; no service module imports, Settings() construction or direct database access. Read-only GET /v1/info supplies whitelisted numeric limits.

provenance.fingerprint_scope: Only listed files at package-spec or deployment-audit-resolved paths, configured discovery files and canonical collector-rules schemas are compared. Existing operations image files and per-service image IDs retain their own provenance.
provenance.probe_scope: Fresh processes read files in the same running containers without importing service modules or constructing Settings(); existing server process module caches are not inspected.

guard_overlay.evidence_scope: Resolved paths and accepted guard deployment audit; settings from that prior audit are not reused as current settings.

service_discovery.policy: Exactly one matching running container must publish the service API port. Matching containers without a published port remain recorded and are not designated as the API-serving instance.
